keyPoints: The team is developing a remote control that must be original, accessible to all age groups, and not a hunk of metal.
The selling price is 25 Euros, which is estimated to be around 17 pounds, with production costs at 12.50 Euros.
The profit aim is 50 million Euros in the first year, with half the selling price covering production costs.
The team is considering simplifying remote control symbols, possibly using an LCD display and menu system like mobile phones.
A suggestion is to include a large print button for older users, or a dual-function menu with clear pictures and symbols.
The team is discussing whether the remote should be made of plastic instead of metal, as it may be cheaper and easier to produce.
The project has a half-hour break before the next meeting, during which individuals will work on their own tasks.
nextSteps: Review the cost implications of using plastic instead of metal for the remote control.
Consider implementing a dual-function menu with clear pictures and symbols for older users.
Explore the idea of a flip-top remote with a larger screen to reduce bulkiness.
Plan the individual work for the next half-hour before the next meeting.
